For a **European hotel development incorporating branded residences**, the brands most commonly considered are concentrated in the luxury and upper-upscale segments.

## Typical brand shortlist

### 1. Ultra-luxury

Best suited to prime capital-city sites, trophy buildings, Mediterranean resorts and exclusive alpine destinations:

- **Mandarin Oriental**
- **Four Seasons**
- **The Ritz-Carlton**
- **St. Regis**
- **Rosewood**
- **Aman**
- **One&Only**
- **Raffles**
- **Six Senses**
- **Bulgari Hotels & Resorts**

Mandarin Oriental currently leads Europe’s hotel-brand residential pipeline, while Four Seasons and Six Senses are also among the region’s most active brands. ([pdf.savills.com](https://pdf.savills.com/documents/branded-residences-europe-report-2026.pdf))

### 2. Established luxury

Often considered where the development needs strong international distribution but a slightly broader buyer profile:

- **Fairmont**
- **Waldorf Astoria**
- **Conrad**
- **Park Hyatt**
- **Regent**
- **Kempinski**
- **Sofitel**
- **JW Marriott**
- **The Luxury Collection**
- **Maybourne**
- **Dorchester Collection**

Accor operates a dedicated mixed-use and branded-residential platform covering brands such as Raffles, Fairmont and its lifestyle portfolio. Hilton’s active residential brands include Waldorf Astoria, Conrad, LXR and Hilton. ([group.accor.com](https://group.accor.com/en/news-stories/accor-one-living-interview-jeff-tisdall?utm_source=openai))

### 3. Luxury lifestyle and design-led

Frequently shortlisted for urban, younger-buyer or entertainment-led developments:

- **W Hotels**
- **EDITION**
- **SLS**
- **SO/**
- **Mondrian**
- **Nobu Hotels**
- **Andaz**
- **Kimpton**
- **The Standard**
- **Autograph Collection**
- **LXR Hotels & Resorts**
- **The Unbound Collection by Hyatt**
- **Vignette Collection**

Marriott’s residential-capable luxury portfolio includes brands such as Ritz-Carlton, St. Regis, W, EDITION, JW Marriott and The Luxury Collection. ([marriott.com](https://www.marriott.com/luxury/about-us?utm_source=openai))

### 4. Upper-upscale and larger mixed-use schemes

Potentially appropriate where residential pricing or hotel economics do not support an ultra-luxury flag:

- **Radisson Blu**
- **Swissôtel**
- **Mövenpick**
- **Westin**
- **Le Méridien**
- **Pullman**
- **Hilton**
- **Radisson**
- **Wyndham**
- **Marriott Hotels**
- **Curio Collection by Hilton**
- **MGallery**

These should not be viewed as secondary options automatically: Radisson Blu, Swissôtel, Kempinski, Radisson and Mövenpick all appear among Europe’s most active residential brands by existing and pipeline project count. ([pdf.savills.com](https://pdf.savills.com/documents/branded-residences-europe-report-2026.pdf))

## Most active brands in Europe

According to Savills’ **Europe 2026** branded-residence analysis, the leading individual hotel brands by completed and pipeline projects are:

1. Mandarin Oriental  
2. Radisson Blu  
3. Four Seasons  
4. Six Senses  
5. Swissôtel  
6. Kempinski  
7. Radisson  
8. The Ritz-Carlton  
9. Mövenpick  
10. St. Regis, Wyndham and One&Only — broadly tied by project count  

At parent-company level, **Marriott has Europe’s largest overall portfolio**, while **Accor has the strongest development pipeline**. ([pdf.savills.com](https://pdf.savills.com/documents/branded-residences-europe-report-2026.pdf))

## Practical shortlisting by project type

| Development type | Brands commonly considered |
|---|---|
| Prime European capital-city trophy project | Mandarin Oriental, Four Seasons, Ritz-Carlton, St. Regis, Raffles, Rosewood, Waldorf Astoria, Park Hyatt |
| Mediterranean luxury resort | Six Senses, One&Only, Four Seasons, Mandarin Oriental, Aman, Rosewood, Ritz-Carlton |
| Alpine or wellness resort | Six Senses, Four Seasons, Aman, One&Only, Kempinski, Mandarin Oriental |
| Design-led urban development | EDITION, W, SLS, SO/, Mondrian, Andaz, Nobu, Kimpton |
| Larger upper-upscale mixed-use scheme | Fairmont, Swissôtel, Mövenpick, Radisson Blu, Hilton, Westin, Autograph Collection |
| Historic conversion or collection-style hotel | Luxury Collection, Autograph Collection, LXR, Curio Collection, MGallery, Unbound Collection, Vignette Collection |

A hotel-plus-residences structure remains particularly conventional in Europe: approximately **86% of completed European hotel-branded residential projects are co-located with a hotel**. ([pdf.savills.com](https://pdf.savills.com/documents/branded-residences-europe-report-2026.pdf))

The appropriate invitation list is normally narrowed based on the precise city or resort, hotel key count, number and value of residences, buyer nationality, expected service charges, residential rental programme and whether the project is management- or franchise-led. Not every brand will approve residences in every market, even if it has an established residential programme.
